added_inspector.title: NextBrain: fine source regions in matched ex vivo MRI
added_inspector.modality: Supplied ex vivo MRI, source segmentation and exact cell boundaries
added_inspector.caption: Explore 98 source-labelled regions with matched ex vivo MRI, native-label schematics and complete source-cell boundaries. The publisher describes a right-hemisphere reference; conflicting side prefixes remain visible in original label names. Source regions are not approved as complete clinical reporting structures.
added_inspector.attribution: NextBrain Data Extension, OpenNeuro ds005422 v1.0.1, DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005422.v1.0.1; CC0. Upstream MRI: Edlow and colleagues, OpenNeuro ds002179 v1.1.0; CC0. Primer derivations retain the supplied voxel values and cell boundaries. The supplied derivative uses a 0.2 mm grid; its exact contrast lineage remains unresolved. This is one fixed postmortem specimen, not a normal-population template or a patient registration.
